name: local_validate_bdfd
description: Compile a BDFD draft without saving or executing it. Returns diagnostics and valid status. Use before proposing BDFD command/workflow creation or edits; runtime_tested=false means Discord behavior is not verified.

bot_id.description: Target bot configuration; defaults to the conversation bot. Without a target, uses official semantics (version 2).

name: local_test_command
description: Execute a BDFD draft or action blocks in the isolated local sandbox. No real Discord, network or production storage access. Returns compact simulated responses, errors, assertions and bounded fixture storage. No trace by default. Use detailed output or a short trace only to diagnose a specific failure. Never present simulation as live Discord verification. Unsupported actions fail explicitly.

scenario.description: Fixtures only: options, variables, global, scoped (scope/context/key), definitions, http, entities, music. Blocks touching Discord read entities.guilds.<guildId> with members (map by user id; members.<id>.voice={channel_id} for voice), channels, roles, messages (by channel id), emojis, invites, webhooks, automod_rules, onboarding; music blocks read music:{userVoiceChannels,tracks,current,queue}. A missing fixture returns the exact key and shape to provide. Role entities use {guilds:{guildId:{roles:[{id,name,color,position,permissions,hoist,mentionable}]}}} and run through the production fetcher; all Discord writes remain denied. HTTP fixtures are consumed once and must match method and URL; each fixture accepts status, body, headers, error and optional expectedRequest (body/headers). Example: http=[{method:"GET",url:"https://example.com/data",status:200,body:{value:42}}]. No external requests are allowed.

expected_content.description: Optional exact expected response text; multiple responses are joined with a newline.

expected_values.description: Optional expected result values keyed by JSON pointer into the returned result, e.g. {"/responses/0/payload/embeds/0/title":"Score"} (embeds is a list; the leading slash is optional). Missing fields and incorrect values fail the contract even when execution succeeds; a missing path comes back with a hint listing the keys that exist.

bot_id.description: Target bot configuration; defaults to the conversation bot. Without a target, uses official semantics (version 2).

trace_limit.description: Maximum returned execution frames (default 0); omitted frames are explicitly counted. Contract checks still inspect the complete result.

result_view.description: Defaults to compact. Detailed includes intermediate results and logs for a concrete failure. Both views bound output size and explicitly report omissions; assertions always inspect the full result.

name: docs_search
description: Search official Bot Creator function documentation.

name: docs_get
description: Read a function document by its slug.

name: docs_plan
description: Start here for any command request: returns the best functions with signatures, applicable gotchas and a ready skeleton in one call. Cheaper than searching.

name: docs_manifest
description: Read the typed Blocks schema: mode 'blocks' lists action parameters (filter with category), mode 'types' lists the nested types (Embed, Component, Condition, Action…). Use before writing blocks JSON.

name: docs_actions
description: List the native block action names with their category and a one-line description.

name: docs_validate_actions
description: Validate a blocks action list against the official schema. Call it on generated blocks and fix every reported error before proposing them.

name: remote_list_bots
description: List the account's cloud bots.

name: remote_bot_status
description: Read a cloud bot's status.

name: remote_start_bot
description: Start a cloud bot using its current saved configuration.

name: remote_stop_bot
description: Stop a cloud bot.

name: local_list_bots
description: List bots saved in this application. Tokens and secrets are excluded.

name: local_bot_status
description: Read local runtime state for a bot.

name: local_start_bot
description: Start a bot on this device using its saved configuration.

name: local_stop_bot
description: Stop a bot on this device.

name: local_list_commands
description: List command settings and revisions without execution code. Filter by exact name to find a target. Use local_get_command for execution, or include_execution only when needed.

name: local_block_registry
description: List supported BDFD functions and visual block types without test fixtures. Filter functions (up to 8 names) and set include_examples=true for their sandbox contracts. For workflow mode, actions_json is an array of blocks with type and payload.

name: local_runtime_reference
description: Read the target runtime dialect, scoped variable signatures and executable BDFD examples including server/member XP with a messageCreate workflow and /level. Read before authoring BDFD storage/math workflows. Does not run scripts or modify the bot.

include_examples.description: Include executable XP workflow/command examples. Default false for a compact dialect/storage reference.

name: local_get_command
description: Read a command and its revision. Use view=settings for description/permissions edits to omit execution code. Default view=full includes execution.

name: local_create_command
description: Create and register a new slash command. Choose execution_mode bdfd_script for BDFD source, javascript for a JavaScript bot, or workflow for visual blocks on a Dart bot. BDFD and JavaScript use script; workflow uses actions_json (JSON array of action blocks). Default is the bot runtime's script mode. Inspect the bot runtime and block registry first. Requires approval.

name: local_update_command_execution
description: Update only an existing command's execution. Choose execution_mode bdfd_script, javascript or workflow. BDFD and JavaScript use script; workflow uses actions_json containing an array of visual action blocks. Preserve the Discord ID, name, options and permissions. Read local_get_command first and pass its revision. Requires approval.

name: local_update_command_options
description: Add, edit or remove a slash command option. Read the command first and pass its revision. Preserve execution and permissions; update existing Discord command and sync cloud. Requires approval.

name: local_update_command_settings
description: Update command description, default permissions, contexts or installation types. Read the command first. Requires approval.

name: local_list_workflows
description: List saved workflows with revisions.

name: local_get_workflow
description: Read a workflow and its revision before editing.

name: local_create_workflow
description: Create a standalone workflow. Inspect runtime, block registry and events first. JavaScript needs a JavaScript runtime; visual blocks or compiled BDFD need Dart. Requires approval.

name: local_update_workflow
description: Modify a saved workflow. Read it first and pass its revision. Preserve unspecified fields and use the bot runtime. Requires approval.

name: local_list_events
description: List supported workflow events and categories.

name: local_get_bot_configuration
description: Read bot profile, presence, variable definitions, schedules, webhooks and section revisions. Secrets excluded.

name: local_get_bot_presence
description: Read saved bot status and activity with revision.

name: local_update_bot_presence
description: Set saved status and activities, then synchronize cloud. Requires approval and current presence revision.

name: local_update_bot_profile
description: Change global Discord bot username. Read configuration and pass profile revision. Requires approval.

name: local_set_variable
description: Set a global value or declare a scoped default definition (not a particular member value). guildMember isolates each server/member pair. Pass the latest variables section revision; dependent variable writes must use the revision returned by the previous write. Requires approval.

name: local_update_scheduled_trigger
description: Create or update a periodic workflow trigger. Pass scheduled_triggers section revision. Requires approval.

name: local_update_inbound_webhook
description: Create or update an inbound webhook linked to a workflow. Credentials are generated in the application and never exposed in chat. Pass inbound_webhooks revision. Requires approval.
